messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to create release/v1.12 tomorrow 09:00 PT. I can do the branch cut unless someone else wants to. Need confirmation on backport rules for bugfix vs feature PRs.
priya: @alex thanks — please include changelog bump PRs in the cut. Cutoff for non-critical features is 08:00 PT tomorrow. :calendar:
matt: Quick recap of rules: only bugfixes (label `backport/patch`) and security hotfixes go into the release branch. New features stay on main unless product signs off on a cherry-pick.
sara: For cherry-picks: target the release branch with a PR, add `backport/approved` label and paste the original PR link in the description. CI will run backport checks. @ci-bot do we still want `(cherry-pick)` in the PR title?
ci-bot: yes — include `(cherry-pick)` in the title. CI will run `release-checks` and failing tests block merge.
alex: Plan for the actual cut: ```git checkout -b release/v1.12 origin/main && git push origin release/v1.12``` I'll run smoke tests and then tag `v1.12.0-rc1`.
priya: Version bump strategy: minor bump (1.12.0) unless a breaking change slips in. Add `changelog/entry` label to any PR that should appear in the release notes.
matt: If you need a backport, ping me with the PR link + commit. I'll triage. Respect `do-not-backport` for experimental work.
sara: Opening a couple small fixes now and tagging them `backport/patch`. @alex when you cut, can you include a release-notes draft in the release PR?
alex: Yep — after cut I'll open the release PR with a template (Highlights, Migration, Deprecations). Drop copy suggestions there and I'll merge. :thumbsup:
priya: Also a reminder: Dedicated infra changes need signoff from the infra team before they go into the release branch — otherwise we risk a rollout hold.
alex: Cool. If no objections I'll cut at 09:00 PT tomorrow. If anyone's blocked, please say now so we can delay or handle blockers.
